categories.main_business_segments: The company specializes in the research, development, production, and sales of ultra-high molecular weight polyethylene (UHMWPE) fibers and their composite materials. It operates a full industry chain from fiber production to composite materials, including products like fine denier fibers, ultra-high strength fibers, anti-creep fibers, and ballistic-resistant non-woven fabrics. The company also produces protective equipment such as bulletproof vests, helmets, and armor plates.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed proprietary core technologies including high-spinnability melt single-filament refining spinning processes, in-line fiber modification, original liquid dyeing, cut-resistant fiber production, and composite armor plate manufacturing. It employs gel spinning technology and advanced composite resin systems to produce lightweight, high-strength, and high-modulus fibers and materials. The production process is highly automated and digitized, with strict quality control and full lifecycle traceability.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include manufacturers in military equipment, public security, aerospace, marine engineering, and safety protection sectors. The company also serves downstream industries such as medical fibers, sports equipment, and robotics. Its products are used in high-end defense applications, industrial ropes, protective clothing, and emerging fields like medical implants and robotic dexterous hands.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with domestic production bases in Beijing, Shandong, and other locations. It also exports products internationally, serving global markets including the United States and Europe. The company maintains stable cooperation with numerous domestic and foreign high-quality customers.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates across the full supply chain from upstream fiber production to midstream composite material manufacturing and downstream protective product assembly. It controls core raw material processing and product customization, positioning itself as an integrated manufacturer in the UHMWPE fiber industry.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include innovation-driven development focusing on high-performance, multifunctional, and green UHMWPE fibers and composites. R&D efforts target product performance upgrades, cost reduction, digital manufacturing, and new application fields such as medical fibers and robotic components. The company emphasizes collaboration with universities and research institutes and actively participates in industry standard setting.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of UHMWPE fibers and composite materials to industrial manufacturers and end-users in defense and safety sectors. The company secures orders via bidding and commercial negotiations, with a focus on customized production and full lifecycle customer service. It also earns income from related product exports and technology services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic player in the UHMWPE fiber industry, recognized for its comprehensive industry chain and technological capabilities. It competes with international brands like Dyneema and SK78 but has achieved significant breakthroughs in product performance and cost competitiveness. The company holds a strong market position in China with growing international recognition.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 649 million, a 1.41% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 130 million, a 15.25% decrease. Total assets reached RMB 1.57 billion, growing 7.75%. The company maintains a stable growth trajectory with increased R&D investment accounting for over 6% of revenue and improved cash flow from operations.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers high-quality UHMWPE fibers and composites with superior mechanical properties, including ultra-high strength, fine denier, anti-creep, and cut resistance. Its products feature lightweight, high impact resistance, and enhanced comfort for protective applications. The company’s flexible production and customization capabilities, combined with advanced digital manufacturing and strong R&D, provide differentiated solutions tailored to diverse customer needs in defense, medical, and industrial markets.
